project.name: Dronley
project.boundarySource: Verified named-place position with a conservative strict editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Completed as an individual, strict-boundary audit on 2026-09-02. Nearby attractions and facilities are excluded unless they lie inside the defined visitor study area.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Dronley Community Woodland and the railway path are genuine See and Trails entries, but the woodland is the attraction: the settlement itself is not a rounded tourist destination.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Outdoor access is useful with responsible close control; indoor policies must be checked separately.
